newsitem.title: UK: British woman convicted of boyfriend's murder.
newsitem.headline: British woman convicted of boyfriend's murder.

text.p: A British woman who alleged her fiance was killed by a stranger in a "road rage" attack was sentenced to life in prison on Tuesday after being found guilty of knifing him to death.
Tracie Andrews, 28, bowed her head but was otherwise emotionless after the jury found her guilty of stabbing Lee Harvey more than 30 times on a dark country lane last year.
"The jury has found you guilty on very strong evidence. Only you know precisely what went on that night but we have all seen the awful consequences," the judge said after the verdict.

In a televised news conference broadcast nationwide soon after the incident, a sobbing and bruised Andrews had described how she and Harvey, 25, were chased down a narrow road by two men in a car after they left a pub.

But police and Harvey's parents became suspicious after inconsistencies in her story were uncovered. Andrews said Harvey had been attacked in the front of the car but a pool of blood showed he had been knifed behind the vehicle.

Traces of Andrews' dyed blonde hair, ripped from the roots, were found embedded under Harvey's fingernails and experts said that blood found on her clothing had come from arterial spurts, not from cradling his body.
The couple also had a history of violent arguments.
Harvey's parents and his young sister wept and hugged each other after the verdict.
"Perhaps now we can put our son to rest," said his mother. Andrews' lawyer plans to appeal against the verdict.
